title: OB-6 NRPN
author: jack
description: On MIDI channel 14, CCs from the Digitone's MIDI tracks are sent to the OB-6 as NRPNs (full parameter set, scaled to each parameter's range). CC numbers that are OB-6 CCs keep their meaning; NRPN-only parameters use free numbers. See the CC map. Set the OB-6's Param Rcv to NRPN.
